train_encoder_decoder_gpt2: train a custom GPT-2 encoder-decoder model for back-translation with paired tree-to-text data
run_back_translation_training: run the back-translation training loop with configurable learning rate, batch size, and epochs
freeze_decoder_weights: freeze the GPT-2 decoder weights so only the encoder is trained during back-translation
load_paired_tree_text_dataset: load paired program tree and chat text datasets for training and validation splits
validate_encoder_decoder_model: validate the trained encoder-decoder model on a held-out validation dataset
